title: Orange & Poppy Seed Cake
description: A bright, citrusy favourite — buttery, fragrant, and layered with a lush orange cream.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 180°C. Grease a deep 28 cm round cake tin and line the base with baking paper.
Combine poppy seeds and milk in a bowl. Let stand for 20 minutes to soften and bloom.
Cream butter, orange zest, and caster sugar with an electric mixer until light and fluffy.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Transfer mixture to a large bowl. Stir in sifted flours, almond meal, poppy seed mixture, and orange juice. Mix until just combined.
Spread into the prepared tin and bake for approximately 45 minutes or until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean.
Cool on a wire rack. Once cold, slice horizontally into three layers.
For the frosting: beat softened cream cheese, sour cream, and orange zest in a medium bowl with an electric mixer until smooth.
Add sifted icing sugar and orange juice. Beat until thick, glossy, and silky.
Sandwich cake layers together with half the orange cream, then cover the top and sides with the remaining cream.

notes.title: Poppy Seed Blooming
notes.content: Soaking the poppy seeds in milk for 20 minutes softens them and releases their nutty flavour into the cake. Do not skip this step.

notes.title: Layer Cake Assembly
notes.content: Use a long serrated knife to slice the cooled cake evenly into three layers. If the cake is slightly warm, chill it for 30 minutes first — cold cake cuts more cleanly.

notes.title: Storage
notes.content: Keep refrigerated due to the cream cheese frosting. Bring to room temperature before serving.
